headline: Mooring Front Joins War’s Active Belt
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt widening. Mooring County has become the freshest flashpoint, recording three base events in two hours and six in the day, with both casualty and enlistment rates accelerating; all twelve bases remain Warden-held. Weathered Expanse is likewise active at three events in two hours and 26 across the day, its ledger standing at five Colonial, three Warden, and one neutral base while recent casualty rates rise. Palantine Berm has logged three events in two hours and 45 in the day, with seven Warden-held bases and casualties still elevated. Nevish Line has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window but retains five events in six hours and 50 across the day, amid a mixed six-Warden, one-Colonial, one-neutral count. Marban Hollow and Callahan’s Passage show no events in two hours, though each remains historically unsettled, with five and 23 daily events respectively. Stlican Shelf has cooled to two events in six hours. Most other regions report no strategic movement, and no victor is recorded.
